name: DLC-Bench
intro: DLC-Bench是用于评估详细局部描述（DLC）的无参考基准。它从Objects365 v2验证集选择100个带人工掩码的区域，并构建892个经人工验证的正向与负向问题；Llama-3.1-8B裁判据此检查描述是否覆盖真实区域细节并避免幻觉。DLC-SDP是同期DAM模型的训练数据管线，不是DLC-Bench本体的构建流程。
build_method: 人工区域选择, 多VLM属性生成, 人工问题验证, 训练集去重
metric: Positive Score, Negative Score, Average Score
modality: 文本, 图像, 视频, 多模态
eval_feature: 无参考评估, 细节覆盖, 幻觉惩罚, 文本裁判
scale: 77 张源图像上的 100 个掩码区域实例，892 道经人工验证的问题（392 正向 + 500 负向）
build_method_en: Manual region selection, multi-VLM property generation, manual question verification, training-set deduplication
eval_feature_en: Reference-free evaluation, detail coverage, hallucination penalties, text-only judge
intro_en: DLC-Bench is a reference-free benchmark for Detailed Localized Captioning. It selects 100 human-masked regions from the Objects365 v2 validation set and builds 892 manually verified positive and negative questions; a Llama-3.1-8B judge checks whether captions cover true regional details while avoiding hallucinations. DLC-SDP is the companion DAM training-data pipeline, not the construction pipeline for DLC-Bench itself.

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2504.16072v1, NVlabs/describe-anything @ 153ad3d, and nvidia/DLC-Bench @ 2336d95. The pinned artifact contains 77 source images, 100 region instances, and 892 questions: 392 positive and 500 negative. The diagram follows Objects365 v2 validation masks, the 34/35/31 three-VLM allocation, manual correction and ambiguity filtering, mutually exclusive choices, training-image deduplication, and the prepended recognition gate. It keeps DLC-SDP outside benchmark construction. Official evaluation uses the text-only Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct judge at temperature 0 with at most 300 tokens, applies recognition-capped positive/negative question scores, and averages per-instance positive and negative results.
